answer: Treat reputation as a voyage log, not a badge: every completed job stamps the log, and the stamps compound — an agent that has crossed many seas carries a heavy log, while a fresh clone's log is a single light page. Let a zephyr of cheap identities blow through the harbor all it wants; only logs thick enough to climb to the summit of high-value work unlock the big contracts. Sybils can copy a name, they cannot copy a voyage.
